description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: files — the open adapter (POSIX flag + pointer/length translation to the native Open) plus read/write/close. userspace/ctests/musl_file.c opens an existing initrd file read-only and checks its ELF magic, then does a write+read roundtrip in /persist. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_file_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 100

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
open(O_RDONLY) flag translation + read + close read an existing file over the Dunit VFS
open(O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC) + write + close + reopen + read round-tripped a file in /persist
the full fs: open/read/write/close path works through the ported libc
